title: minuartia glomerata subsp. burnatii
intro: Minuartia glomerata subsp. burnatii, commonly known as Alpine Rock-Cress or Alpine Rockcress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe, where it thrives in dry, rocky areas. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Minuartia glomerata subsp. burnatii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
